questions.prompt: The weather is cloudy. It ______ rain later.
questions.explanation: may 后接动词原形，不随主语变化，也不加 to 或 -ing。因此选 may。
questions.evidence: We may find more problems when we start work.

questions.prompt: A payment was possibly delayed yesterday; this is not yet confirmed. The payment ___ by the bank.
questions.explanation: 过去可能发生的被动事件用 might have been delayed。might delay tomorrow 改成将来；must have delayed 缺少这里需要的被动结构且推断过强；cannot have been delayed 则排除了可能。
questions.evidence: A payment was possibly delayed yesterday; this is not yet confirmed. The payment might have been delayed by the bank.

options: The train may to arrive late.
questions.explanation: 情态动词 may 不随主语变化，后接动词原形 arrive，因此正确句为 The train may arrive late。
questions.evidence: We may find more problems when we start work.

questions.prompt: We are not sure about the cost. The repair ______ more than £80,000.
questions.explanation: might 后接动词原形 cost，表示不确定的可能性。因此选 might cost。
questions.evidence: We may find more problems when we start work.

questions.prompt: The donor will pay only on condition that the library moves. Preserve that necessary condition: The donor will pay ___ the library moves.
questions.explanation: only if保留“搬迁是付款必要条件”；even if和whether or not弱化或取消条件，as though表示仿佛。
questions.evidence: The donor will pay only on condition that the library moves. Preserve that necessary condition: The donor will pay only if the library moves.

questions.prompt: The council ______ not have enough money for a new building.
questions.explanation: may not + 动词原形表示“可能不”。may 不随主语变化，因此选 may。
questions.evidence: We may find more problems when we start work.

questions.prompt: Refer to costs that have not yet been confirmed: The costs ___ in the preliminary report are estimates, not invoices.
questions.explanation: projected作过去分词后置修饰costs，相当于that are projected；完整谓语或多余宾语会破坏这里的主句结构。估计不等于已收到账单。
questions.evidence: Refer to costs that have not yet been confirmed: The costs projected in the preliminary report are estimates, not invoices.

questions.prompt: Express that the move remains merely possible: The committee said the library ___ move after the review, but no decision had been made.
questions.explanation: might保留尚未决定的可能性；must definitely写成必然，had already写成已发生（且后应moved），cannot possibly排除可能，均改变意思。
questions.evidence: Express that the move remains merely possible: The committee said the library might move after the review, but no decision had been made.

instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
may/might +动词原形表示可能，不保证结果；两者强弱取决于语境，不能机械按固定概率排序。may/might have +过去分词表示对过去的可能推断，may have been +过去分词则兼有被动意义。条件句only if表示必要条件；条件尚未满足不能把承诺写成已到账。修饰costs的分词短语或关系从句要区分预计、承诺与已经发生。

We may find more problems when we start work.
